svg.title: Figure - software usage and data hand-off
svg.desc: Input: two folders of raw files, one file per sample, plus a two-column sample group sheet supplied before the run. MSGeter, tab 1, turns each raw file into a six-column block, concatenates the blocks of a group into one workbook, and separately writes every MS2 scan to a csv index and to a per-sample msp file; the optional Ms2Geter and RtGeter modules answer two narrower questions. DMetFinder, tab 2, reads one workbook per group and runs six fixed stages: six-column block parsing into the rtMz key, an intensity matrix within a 0.002 window, a 50 percent and an 80 percent recurrence filter, a product score of intensity times count times relative intensity, an isotope lookup at fixed mass offsets, and a cross-group comparison within 0.003. It writes nine workbooks holding eighteen sheets, of which the differential-ion summary is the one carried downstream to structure elucidation tools.
